description: Search HireJack's database of live tech job postings. Filter by keyword, role family, seniority, skill, location, salary, remote policy, or visa sponsorship, and sort by newest or highest pay. Returns a slim list of jobs with title, company, location, salary range, posted date, and key skills. Use this for queries like 'remote senior backend roles paying $200K+', 'highest paying Rust jobs' (sort='salary'), 'data engineer jobs at fintech companies', 'who is hiring Rust developers in NYC'. Not for a single known posting (`get_job`), company-level questions (`get_company_profile`), personalized ranking (`recommendations`), or aggregate market stats (`get_market_pulse`).

company.description: Company domain to filter by, e.g. 'stripe.com'

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous search_jobs call's `meta.next_cursor`. Pass it back with the SAME filters AND the same `sort` to fetch the next page of results.

education.description: Minimum degree the job requires (AI-extracted). E.g. 'bachelor' returns jobs whose stated requirement is exactly a bachelor's.

experience.description: Years-of-experience bucket the job asks for (AI-extracted yearsMin). E.g. '0-2' for entry-level-friendly roles, '10+' for very senior ones.

family.description: Role family (software_engineering, machine_learning, etc.). Omit to search all families.

has_salary.description: Set true to only include jobs with a disclosed salary range; omit to include jobs without pay data.

location.description: Location substring filter, e.g. 'San Francisco' or 'New York'

posted_since.description: Only include jobs posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). E.g. for 'jobs posted this week', pass the date 7 days ago.

q.description: Free-text keyword search (case-insensitive substring) across raw and standardized title, company name, company domain, and location. Tip: use the `skill` parameter for skill matches — `q` does NOT search job descriptions or the skill list.

remote.description: Remote policy filter; 'remote+hybrid' matches either mode. Omit to include onsite jobs too.

salary_max.description: Maximum salary ceiling (annual USD). Matches jobs whose floor is at or below this (i.e. salaryMin <= X).

salary_min.description: Minimum salary floor (annual USD). Matches jobs whose disclosed salary range *could pay at least* this much (i.e. salaryMax >= X). A job with range $150K–$250K matches salary_min=200000.

seniority.description: Seniority level on the intern → vp ladder. Omit to include all levels.

skill.description: Single skill name to require (case-insensitive substring match), e.g. 'Rust' or 'Kubernetes'

sort.description: Result ordering. 'newest' (default) returns the most recently posted first. 'salary' ranks by the TOP of each disclosed USD range, highest first — use it for 'highest paying' / 'best paid' queries. Jobs with no disclosed pay or a non-USD range sink to the end in newest-first order, so combine with has_salary=true for a clean pay ranking.

visa.description: Visa sponsorship (AI-extracted): 'yes' returns jobs whose posting indicates sponsorship, 'no' those that rule it out. Omit to include jobs where the posting doesn't say.

name: search_jobs

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: Search results page; meta.next_cursor is present when more pages exist

count.description: Jobs in this page (not the corpus total)

jobs.description: Matching jobs, ordered by the requested `sort` (newest first by default, highest disclosed pay first when sort='salary')

ai_summary.description: 2-3 sentence AI summary when available (get_job only)

company_domain.description: e.g. 'stripe.com' — pass to get_company_profile or company_fit

education.description: Stated degree requirement, e.g. 'bachelor', or null

id.description: Raw canonical job id — pass back to get_job, match_job, save_job, or track_application

location.description: Normalized location, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA' or 'Remote (US)'

salary.description: Disclosed pay range, or null when the posting lists none

title.description: Standardized title when available, else the raw posting title

years_min.description: Minimum years of experience the posting asks for, or null

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: Search Jobs
